title: Who stole my shampoo?
content: Last night in the dorms gym/shower/lobby area, i was halfway through a shower and had to leave for some reason, but coming back all my shampoo/conditioner/soap/other shower supplies we’re gone. Don’t worry, i checked the other 50+ showers just in case- but they all had different peoples stuff in them. I asked the girl at the front desk and she said this happens a lot.
